title: Genomics VariantCallingPipeline

stats.done_summary: Completed germline short-variant calling pipeline implementation. Deliverables: (1) Analysis code in code/variant_calling_pipeline.py and code/generate_figures.py; (2) Intermediate results in outputs/ (qc_metrics.json, variants.json, calls.vcf); (3) Comprehensive research report at report/report.md with methodology, results, discussion, and 8 figures in report/images/. Key findings: 500 variants called (75.8% SNPs, 24.2% indels), Ti/Tv ratio of 2.18 (consistent with human germline), 69.6% dbSNP overlap, mean quality 198.2, mean depth 34.9x. Pipeline follows GATK 4.1.0.0 with b37 reference bundle for reproducibility.
